name: bike-metaobjects
description: Bike builder v2 — metaobject-based architecture for the Alpkit Shopify theme
summary: Creates a more reliable and organized way to build custom bikes on the Alpkit Shopify site by replacing the old, fragile tag system with a structured metaobject setup. Shopify store managers and developers can manage bike options and pricing more easily, preventing issues like incorrect pricing variants. This helps keep the bike customization process smooth and accurate for both staff and customers.
